latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agency-git-workflow-master.

- Introduces an expert agent specializing in Git workflow mastery.
- Defines clear roles: clean commits, smart branching strategies, and safe team collaboration.
- Highlights advanced Git capabilities: worktrees, bisect, reflog, and CI integration.
- Agent profile includes a memory of best practices and real-world rescue experience.
- Usage instructions included for easy activation by reference.
